description: Phase 1 model-profile template for opencode-orchestrator-kit. Editable by the user; copied to .opencode/models.config.json by install.sh. Agent frontmatter references logical tiers ({{TIER_ROUTER}}, {{TIER_REASONING}}, {{TIER_CODE}}, {{TIER_FAST}}, {{TIER_REVIEW}}) instead of hardcoded model IDs; install.sh / scripts/apply-model-preset.py resolve tokens to concrete provider/model IDs at install time using the preset selected below. Two profiles are shipped: `default` (known-good) and `generic` (unresolved placeholders meant to be edited by the user).

tiers.TIER_ROUTER: Routing agent — used by orchestrator. Falls back to TIER_REASONING when omitted.
tiers.TIER_REASONING: Deep reasoning / architecture / orchestration — used by oracle, security, planner. Required.
tiers.TIER_CODE: Implementation, code authoring, and test-writing — used by developer-fixer and test-engineer. Required.
tiers.TIER_FAST: Lightweight utility and high-throughput tasks — used by profiler, explorer, librarian, build-helper, npm-helper, deploy-helper, pc-doctor, writer. Required.
tiers.TIER_REVIEW: General correctness / quality review — used by code-reviewer. Falls back to TIER_CODE when omitted.

default.label: OpenCode Go + Ollama Cloud (known-good)
default.description: Known-good default profile mirroring the kit's out-of-the-box behavior: a flagship reasoning model, cloud-hosted specialists for code and review, and a fast cloud model for utility tasks. Validates clean against scripts/validate-models.sh.

generic.label: Generic profile (unresolved placeholders — edit before use)
generic.description: Editable generic profile with placeholder/* sentinel values for every required tier. The placeholder/* prefix is reserved: scripts/validate-models.sh exits non-zero while any value still starts with 'placeholder/', and scripts/apply-model-preset.py refuses to apply a preset that still has unresolved placeholders. Edit each tier to a real provider/model ID, save, then re-run scripts/validate-models.sh.
